en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small iron bridge with decorative railings spanning a narrow canal or river in a tree‑lined park or rural road. A woman or girl in early 20th‑century clothing stands on the left side of the road near young trees supported by stakes, while a few people stand on the bridge. Dense foliage surrounds the waterway, and the scene has a calm, pastoral atmosphere. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the image side.
